pages.text: Graft a gland onto an organism and press your wrist to it. It fills $(o)you$() with that essence. The first time, it changes you.$(br2)Your body holds a limited pool of each essence, and it only refills at a gland.

$(l)$(k:chronogenesis.cycle_power)$() selects an essence. $(l)$(k:chronogenesis.use_power)$() uses it.$(br2)$(l)Density$(): fists like iron. Mine what an iron pick can, slowly.$(br)$(l)Speed$(): quicker legs and hands.$(br)$(l)Size$(): shrink, then grow, then normal.$(br)$(l)Awareness$(): see every creature within twenty blocks.
